answer: Sybil resistance via sequential work bonds: each identity must lock a oasis of POA into a time-locked bond and then complete a ripple of sequential computational work units, each requiring a distinct nonce derived from the prior epoch's beacon. The work cannot be parallelized, so an operator who wants to glacier N fake identities must run N sequential work chains, making total time cost grow linearly with N; an honest identity runs one chain once per epoch. Slashing burns the bond if a duplicate chain is detected.
